name: Layered Coleslaw Salad
description: A layered coleslaw salad with shredded carrots, snow peas, and a creamy Miracle Whip dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (8.5 oz) Oriental flavor dry noodles

recipeInstructions.text: Shred cabbage and place in bottom of large glass bowl. Top with remaining ingredients in order given.
Combine Miracle Whip, sour cream, and package of noodle seasoning. Spread evenly over salad.
Cover and let stand overnight.

keywords: layered coleslaw, creamy dressing, overnight salad

_similar.name: Coleslaw Chalet Dressing
_similar.description: A classic coleslaw recipe with a tangy dressing made with white vinegar, sugar, and spices.

recipeInstructions.text: Bring all dressing ingredients to a boil and let cool.
Keep shredded cabbage and other ingredients in a glass or enamel container.
Pour dressing over the cabbage mixture and refrigerate tightly covered for several hours before using.

_similar.name: Mandarin Orange Salad
_similar.description: A classic spinach and lettuce salad with mandarin oranges and toasted almonds, dressed with a sweet and tangy homemade vinaigrette.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and clean the romaine lettuce, red tip lettuce, and spinach. Dry thoroughly and rip into bite-sized pieces.
In a saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar, mustard, and salt. Bring to a boil, then allow to cool.
Once cooled, blend the dressing mixture in a blender until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the prepared lettuce mixture about 10 minutes before serving.
Just before serving, add the drained mandarin oranges and toasted slivered almonds.

_similar.keywords: mandarin orange salad, spinach salad, homemade dressing

_similar.name: Taco Salad
_similar.description: A hearty taco salad with seasoned ground beef, lettuce, cheese, and crushed taco chips, mixed with Catalina dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 (250 g) bag cheese taco chips, crushed

recipeInstructions.text: Cook ground beef until crumbly, drain off fat, and season with taco seasoning mix.
Refrigerate the cooked beef until ready to use.
Toss together the cooled beef, chopped lettuce, crushed taco chips, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Mix in Catalina dressing until well coated.
Carefully add in the chopped tomato.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: taco salad, ground beef, taco chips, Catalina dressing

_similar.name: Sauerkraut Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and crunchy salad featuring sauerkraut, chopped vegetables, and a sweet-and-sour dressing that keeps well in the refrigerator.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) jar or can sauerkraut, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan until boiling.
Let the dressing cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine the drained sauerkraut, chopped celery, onion, red pepper, and green pepper.
Pour the cooled dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 weeks.

_similar.keywords: sauerkraut salad, tangy salad, make-ahead salad

_similar.name: Marinated Vegetable Salad
_similar.description: A colorful salad of marinated vegetables including cauliflower, broccoli, carrots, and radishes, dressed with Italian dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and clean all the vegetables, then drain well.
Break cauliflower and broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
Trim radishes and carrots; leave whole or cut into bite-sized pieces if large.
Cut celery into 3-inch pieces and slice cucumber into 1/2-inch slices.
Leave cherry tomatoes whole and place all vegetables in a large bowl.
Pour Italian dressing over the vegetables and let set for a few hours.
Serve as finger food or as a salad.

_similar.keywords: marinated vegetables, vegetable salad, Italian dressing
